meta.title: Benedy Football Coaching — Miami-Dade County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Miami, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Benedy
about.bio: Former High school/college athlete. Been training and coaching athletes for over 10years now, I've had some clients made it to the NFL, college competitive sports, and more. This is a passion of mine, I love helping an athlete that wants to be Great reach the next level competitive spirit/skills.

hero.headline: Miami-Dade County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.

testimonials.quote: Coach Benedy has a gift for breaking down the fundamentals. My kid went from nervous on the field to one of the most confident players on the team.
testimonials.name: Derrick M.

testimonials.quote: Nobody pushes me the right way like Coach Benedy does. Every session I leave better than I came.
testimonials.name: Jordan R.
